QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_18

question.text: What is the SEBI-prescribed timeline for an AIF Manager to redress an investor grievance under the SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023?

answer.text: 21 calendar days from receipt of grievance

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the 2023 amendment, AIF Managers shall redress investor grievances within 21 calendar days from the date of receipt of the grievance. Complaints are lodged via SCORES and the Action Taken Report (ATR) is routed through that system. The Trap: 7 days is too aggressive; 90 days confuses with other timelines; 'next financial year' is absurd. Note: Pages 282-283 of the workbook set the 21-calendar-day timeline and describe the SCORES/ATR flow and subsequent review mechanism.
